purpose: Teach: 島田/町田/森山/前原/足立/平山/椎名/村田

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、島田刑事の現場対応も評価されますね
lines.en: The police certainly value Officer Shimada's fieldwork and response.
lines.style: Measured, respectful acknowledgment. Steady pace, professional tone. Recognition without flattery—a genuine nod to competence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、参考人町田氏から、警察、事情を伺われますね
lines.en: The police are careful to hear the account from witness Machida.
lines.style: Even rhythm, procedural tone. Understated—not praising, but noting the diligent process. Almost administrative in manner.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、被害者森山氏のご家族にも、警察、配慮されますね
lines.en: The police show real consideration toward the victim Moriyama's family.
lines.style: Warmer here—genuine respect for pastoral care. Still professional, but the warmth comes through in the phrasing. Slight emphasis on 'consideration.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、目撃者前原氏の供述を、警察、整えられますね
lines.en: The police carefully document the witness statement from Maehara.
lines.style: Back to procedural efficiency. Precise, methodical delivery. The kind of voice noting that thoroughness matters, detail by detail.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者足立の前科を、警察、確認されますね
lines.en: The police verify the prior record of suspect Adachi.
lines.style: Factual and direct. No judgment in the voice—just the necessary work. Clean, efficient phrasing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、署内の鑑識平山主任と現場検証されますね
lines.en: The police conduct a thorough scene investigation with forensics chief Hirayama.
lines.style: Methodical, appreciative of the partnership. Slight emphasis on 'thorough.' The voice of someone who knows this collaboration is essential.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、心理士椎名様にご助言を仰がれますね
lines.en: The police seek counsel from psychologist Shiina on the case.
lines.style: Respectful deference to expertise. Slightly lighter than before—recognition that the specialist brings something essential. Warm professional tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、検事の村田様と公判前協議もされますね
lines.en: The police also discuss pre-trial procedures with prosecutor Murata.
lines.style: Shift to ease and familiarity. This is the closing line—slightly more relaxed, the tone of colleagues who've worked together before. Still professional but warmer.
